Subject: Need help with a divorce by mutual consent case

Hello, my name is Madhuri Ghosh. I am a 53-year-old textile trader living in Kolkata. My spouse Pranav Apte and I want a divorce by mutual consent with a settlement of Rs 60,70,000, and both spouses have lived apart for a long time. My case number is Petition No. 1281/2025 in the Family Court at Kolkata. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 92842 14024 or email madhuri.ghosh41@example.com.
